calls.thesis: Valuation mirage: AI capex boom hides -$28B TTM free cash flow and ~$120B debt; 10-yr borrowing cost rose 5.7% (Feb) to ~7.3%; Project Jupiter force majeure shows execution strain. -53% over past year with more downside ahead.
Force majeure on the 2.5GW New Mexico data center could be 'the first crack in the entire AI boom'; worst of the neo-cloud group, -53% since May, -5.1x debt-to-FCF.
